versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called with Active is set to TRUE , the secured association is enabled and EthTrcvMacSe- cEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • the given API parameter Active is set to TRUE • the transmission secured association given with An exists and has already been enabled then the EthTrcv driver shall update the transmission secure association at the PHY that corresponds to the given TrcvIdx by considering the next packet number (see NextPn ) and return with E_OK . Otherwise, if the addressed transmission secured as- sociation does not exist, return with E_NOT_OK .
